categories.main_business_segments: Aekyung Industrial Co., Ltd. operates primarily in two business segments: cosmetics and household goods. The cosmetics segment includes skincare and color cosmetics with brands such as AGE20'S, Luna, Point &, and A Solution. The household goods segment covers products like shampoo, toothpaste, laundry and dish detergents, and personal hygiene items with brands including Spark, Riqu, Wool Shampoo, Le Chatra, Soonsem, Trio, Kerasis, 2080, Shower Mate, and Labsin.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes proprietary research and development capabilities with in-house cosmetics and household goods research centers and design centers. It employs advanced formulation technologies such as essence pocket technology in cosmetics, multi-enzyme formulations in detergents, and patented antimicrobial coating technologies in cleaning products. Production capacity is managed across multiple plants with continuous investment in machinery and logistics infrastructure to enhance production efficiency and capacity.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Aekyung serves both domestic and international markets, targeting retail consumers through various channels. Cosmetics are sold mainly via home shopping, H&B stores, online platforms, and exports, while household goods are distributed through retail stores, online, dealerships, special sales, and exports. Key export markets include China, Southeast Asia, Japan, and North America, with a strong focus on localized products and marketing strategies for these regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in South Korea with significant export activities to China, Southeast Asia, Japan, the United States, and other global markets. It maintains a global sales organization and a Shanghai subsidiary to support overseas operations. Domestic sales account for approximately 65% of revenue, with exports making up 35%. The company is expanding its presence in emerging and developed markets through diversified channels.
categories.supply_chain_position: Aekyung operates as an integrated manufacturer and distributor, controlling the supply chain from product planning, research and development, production, logistics, to sales. It owns production facilities, research centers, and logistics centers, enabling end-to-end management of product development and distribution. This vertical integration allows for rapid response to market trends and quality control.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in premium and natural product formulations, focusing on functional cosmetics and eco-friendly household products. R&D efforts emphasize advanced skincare technologies, multi-functional detergents, and sustainable packaging. Strategic initiatives include expanding digital marketing capabilities, developing channel-specific products, and enhancing global market penetration through localized product development and marketing collaborations.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of cosmetics and household goods across multiple channels including retail, online, home shopping, and exports. The company also leverages brand licensing and distribution agreements in international markets. Sales are supported by targeted marketing campaigns and channel-specific product offerings to maximize market reach and profitability.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Aekyung competes in the highly competitive Korean cosmetics and household goods markets against both domestic and multinational companies. It holds a strong market position with notable brand recognition, especially in essence foundation cosmetics and premium detergent categories. The company differentiates itself through innovation, diversified product portfolios, and expanding global footprint, maintaining steady market shares in key product categories.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, Aekyung reported consolidated revenues of approximately 668.9 billion KRW, reflecting a 9.6% year-over-year growth. Operating profit increased by 58.7% to 61.9 billion KRW, with an operating margin of 9.3%. The company’s total assets stood at about 482.4 billion KRW with equity of 387.6 billion KRW, showing stable financial health and ongoing investments in production and logistics infrastructure. The growth trajectory is supported by expanding exports and premium product lines.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Aekyung emphasizes high-quality, innovative products that combine advanced technology with consumer trends such as natural ingredients and premium formulations. Its unique essence pocket technology in cosmetics and patented enzyme and antimicrobial technologies in household products provide superior performance. The company’s integrated supply chain enables rapid product development and market responsiveness, while its diversified brand portfolio caters to a wide range of consumer needs domestically and internationally.
